 Super Bowl 2027 performers: Who could headline the Halftime Show?
 Miley Cyrus, JAY-Z, Harry Styles and Justin Bieber are among the rumored Super Bowl 2027 performers. But one unexpected detail has fans questioning when the big reveal will happen
 © Jeff Kravitz/FilmMagic.com 
 Shirley Gomez Senior Writer OCTOBER 15, 2026 12:39 PM EDT OCT 15, 2026, 12:39 PM EDT 
 The countdown to Super Bowl 2027 is underway, and one major question remains unanswered: Who will perform at the halftime show? With the NFL's biggest night returning to Los Angeles on February 14, 2027, music fans are eager to discover which superstar will take center stage at SoFi Stadium. And this year's announcement is taking longer than expected.
 As of October 15, 2026, the NFL has not officially announced the Super Bowl 2027 halftime show performer. However, several major artists are emerging as potential headliners, including Miley Cyrus , JAY-Z , Harry Styles , and Justin Bieber .
 © Kevin Mazur/Getty Images 
 © FIFA via Getty Images 
 © WWD 
 © Getty Images 
 The speculation has intensified following a mysterious social media image that some fans believed revealed the performer. Unfortunately for those hoping to solve the mystery early, the supposed leak appears to have been fabricated. 
 Who Is Performing at the Super Bowl 2027 Halftime Show?
 The official performer for Super Bowl LXI has yet to be revealed, but that hasn't stopped fans from making predictions.
 According to an October 15 report from Covers , prediction markets have fluctuated considerably as fans weigh the possibility of several superstar performers. Miley Cyrus and JAY-Z have repeatedly emerged as favorites, while Harry Styles has also attracted growing attention.

 Here are the biggest names currently being discussed.
 Miley Cyrus Could Finally Get Her Super Bowl Moment
 Miley Cyrus is one of the most prominent names associated with the Super Bowl 2027 halftime show. The Grammy-winning singer has spent two decades building a career that spans pop, rock, and country influences. From her Disney Channel beginnings as Hannah Montana to hits like "Flowers," "Wrecking Ball" and "Party in the U.S.A.," Cyrus has the kind of recognizable catalog that could translate into a spectacular halftime performance.
 © Getty Images for Palm Springs In Miley Cyrus announces 20th anniversary 'Hannah Montana' special: 'I'll always be thankful' 
 Her versatility could also make for an entertaining show. Imagine a setlist that moves from nostalgic Disney-era favorites to powerhouse vocals and rock-inspired performances.
 The speculation intensified in early October when a screenshot allegedly showing a deleted Apple Music teaser began circulating online. Some viewers believed the silhouette resembled Cyrus.
 Could JAY-Z Headline the Super Bowl Halftime Show Himself?
 JAY-Z's name is particularly interesting because he already has a major role in shaping the Super Bowl's musical entertainment. Through Roc Nation's partnership with the NFL, established in 2019, the rapper and entrepreneur has helped guide the league's music and entertainment strategy.
 That involvement makes the possibility of JAY-Z stepping onto the stage himself especially intriguing. With a catalog that includes "Empire State of Mind," "99 Problems" and "Run This Town," the rapper has more than enough material for a memorable performance.
 © Backgrid/The Grosby Group Beyoncé on stage with Jay-Z as he delivered a career-spanning hometown spectacle during his "Extra Innings" concert at Yankee Stadium 
 A JAY-Z halftime show could also create opportunities for collaborations with artists from his extensive musical history.
 Beyoncé , Alicia Keys and Rihanna would be exciting potential guests, although none has been announced for a JAY-Z-led performance. The biggest question is whether the executive producer might finally become the headliner. 
 Harry Styles Is Another Major Super Bowl 2027 Contender
 Harry Styles is another artist whose name has gained momentum in the Super Bowl halftime conversation. The former One Direction member has established himself as a successful solo performer, with hits including "As It Was," "Watermelon Sugar," and "Sign of the Times."
 His energetic performances, colorful fashion choices, and cross-generational appeal could make him a compelling choice for the NFL's biggest musical event.
 © Getty Harry Styles is hitting the road with the help of some friends 
 Styles also has the kind of devoted fan base that could introduce additional viewers to the broadcast.
 A surprise appearance from his former One Direction bandmates would undoubtedly create a memorable television moment, but there is no indication that such a reunion is planned.
 Justin Bieber Could Make a Major Return to the Spotlight
 Justin Bieber is another superstar whose name has surfaced in speculation surrounding the 2027 halftime show. With global hits such as "Baby," "Sorry," "Peaches," and "Love Yourself," Bieber has a catalog that would be instantly recognizable to millions of viewers.
 A halftime performance could also offer an opportunity to celebrate his evolution from teenage pop sensation to established international artist.
 © Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for Coa Justin Bieber performs at the Coachella Stage during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club 
 His history of collaborations would leave plenty of possibilities for surprise appearances, potentially adding another layer of excitement to the show.
 Why Hasn't the Super Bowl 2027 Performer Been Announced?
 One of the most unusual details about the upcoming halftime show is the timing of the announcement. In recent years, the NFL has typically revealed its headlining performer in September.
 Bad Bunny was announced for the 2026 show in September 2025. Kendrick Lamar , Usher , and Rihanna were also revealed during September in their respective announcement years.
 © Brooke Sutton Bad Bunny performs during the Apple Music Halftime Show during the NFL Super Bowl LX football game between the New England Patriots and the Seattle Seahawks at Levi's Stadium on February 08, 2026 in Santa Clara, California. (Photo by Brooke Sutton/Getty Images) 
 But October 2026 is already halfway over, and the NFL has yet to identify its next headliner. According to USA TODAY reporting, six of the previous seven halftime performers were announced in September, making this year's delay particularly noticeable. 
 When and Where Is Super Bowl 2027?
 Super Bowl 2027 falls on Valentine's Day, Sunday, February 14, 2027. That could create opportunities for a romantic theme, love-song medleys, or collaborations between iconic musical couples, although organizers have not announced any such plans. The game will also mark the second time SoFi Stadium has hosted a Super Bowl.
 The stadium previously hosted Super Bowl LVI in 2022, when Dr. Dre, Snoop Dogg, Eminem, Mary J. Blige and Kendrick Lamar delivered a star-studded halftime performance, with additional appearances from 50 Cent and Anderson .Paak. 
 Who Performed at the Super Bowl 2026 Halftime Show?
 Before the conversation turned to the 2027 performers, Bad Bunny took center stage at Super Bowl LX on February 8, 2026.
 The Puerto Rican superstar brought his music and cultural identity to one of television's most prominent stages, demonstrating the international reach of the halftime show.
 © Kevin Sabitus Bad Bunny carries the Puerto Rican flag during one of his concerts, a gesture that has become a constant in his tribute to the island and his roots. 
 His performance also reinforced how the NFL's entertainment choices have expanded beyond traditional American pop and rock headliners.
 Following artists such as Rihanna, Usher, Kendrick Lamar, and Bad Bunny, the next performer will face enormous expectations.
